text: {"memo": "On March 31, 2025, the freshest read was for fiscal 2024, which ended December 28, 2024. Disney’s revenue reached $237.2 billion, up 15% from $204.7 billion in fiscal 2023 and versus $179.5 billion in fiscal 2022. Net income increased to about $11.2 billion from $8.2 billion in fiscal 2023, and diluted EPS was $1.39, or $1.51 on an adjusted basis. Operating margin was thin, around 5%, with net margin near 5%. Cash flow from operations was about $24.2 billion, and free cash flow was roughly $18 billion. The prior fiscal year, 2023, generated revenue of $204.7 billion, net income of $8.2 billion, EPS of $1.25, and operating cash flow of about $21.8 billion. Fiscal 2022 produced revenue of $179.5 billion, net income of $5.3 billion, and EPS of $0.67 as the pandemic recovery began. Across FY2022-FY2024, Disney showed a rebound in revenue and earnings, but profitability and streaming economics lagged pre-pandemic levels. The stock as of the 2025-03-31 update appeared to offer a contrarian recovery play, though execution and margin risks persisted."}
